question: Does the complete Flight Day 6 raw crew-camera label set split any single camera-recorded five-exposure bracket across multiple activity_id facets?
terminal_objective: Measure activity-facet fragmentation with a content-independent camera-action oracle before deciding whether archive activity filters can be treated as item-level observation truth.
authority: Read-only public-source metadata acquisition and private local repository updates only. No image pixels, publication, outreach, scientific acceptance, or correction of NASA source labels.

baseline.known_case_state: One five-frame Z9 bracket is split 4:1 between 24_Sunset and 25_Discussion #6: Forward Look. Stage 10A may quantify only against a complete prospectively defined denominator.

complete_bracket_contract.selection: Within each instrument serial, sort by shutter_count and admit each non-overlapping five-record window satisfying every rule. The bracket-value sequence makes overlapping admissions impossible under valid data.

scored_outcomes.activity_facet_fracture: A complete bracket contains more than one non-empty activity_id.
scored_outcomes.target_presence_fracture: A complete bracket has target_id on some but not all frames.
scored_outcomes.target_value_fracture: A complete bracket contains more than one non-empty target_id.
scored_outcomes.primary_metric: activity-fractured complete brackets divided by all complete brackets
scored_outcomes.interpretation: A fractured bracket proves that one camera action is fragmented across activity facets. It does not identify the correct activity or establish image content.

artifact_native_falsifier: The complete Flight Day 6 raw-label denominator contains no qualifying five-frame bracket with more than one activity_id.
claim_ceiling: Stage 10A may establish the complete Flight Day 6 five-exposure-bracket denominator and whether any one camera action is fragmented across activity_id facets. It cannot identify the correct tag, infer image content, estimate error across non-bracket products or other flight days, invalidate the pixel archive, or establish scientific findings.

next_step_logic.if_none: Retire the systematic-fragmentation lead for the qualified bracket cohort and return to synthesis or a different archive question.
next_step_logic.if_sparse: Treat activity_id as a useful coarse search facet with a demonstrated item-level boundary failure; inspect only the fractured bracket contexts and avoid an archive-wide error-rate claim.
next_step_logic.if_recurrent: Test whether fractures concentrate at activity boundaries or camera-specific authoring transitions before recommending any retrieval warning.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: A revised PDS label version, a documented activity-tag generation procedure, or a second independently qualified product class may change the interpretation.
